words.m: we; I in some northern informal contexts

characters.note: Recognize 情 in 热情. This usage note is not an origin or decomposition claim.

grammar.pattern: 大家 / 别人 / 自己 · 它 / 它们 · 咱 / 咱们
grammar.purpose: Refer to the right people or things
grammar.explanation: 大家 refers to everyone in the relevant group; 别人 means other people. 自己 refers back to the relevant person: 我自己 / 他自己; do not assume its referent without context. 它/它们 normally refer to things or animals in writing. 咱们 explicitly includes the listener; 我们 may include or exclude them. 咱 is northern and informal, and can represent I or we according to context; 咱们 is clearer for inclusive we.

examples.zh: 大家先介绍自己，再听别人介绍。
examples.py: dà jiā xiān jiè shào zì jǐ , zài tīng bié ren jiè shào .
examples.en: Everyone introduces themselves first, then listens to others.

examples.zh: 两本书在桌上，它们是我的。
examples.py: liǎng běn shū zài zhuō shàng , tā men shì wǒ de .
examples.en: The two books are on the table; they are mine.

examples.zh: 咱一起读吧。咱们都参加，你也来。
examples.py: zán yì qǐ dú ba . zán men dōu cān jiā , nǐ yě lái .
examples.en: Let us read together. All of us, including you, will participate.

commonMistakes.right: 我介绍我自己，大家介绍自己。
commonMistakes.why: Keep 自己 attached to the intended person; 大家自己 does not mean just me.

grammar.purpose: Recognize five ways words form a phrase
grammar.explanation: A phrase need not be a full sentence. Coordination joins equals: 读书和聊天. Modification describes a head: 年轻的老师 / 很热情. Verb-object pairs an action and its object: 参加活动. Verb-complement adds a result or direction to an action: 读懂 / 走出来. Subject-predicate pairs a topic with what is said about it: 大家热情. These structural labels do not replace meaning or license arbitrary combinations; 读懂 is a recognition example here and gets fuller result-complement practice later.

examples.zh: 读书和聊天，是今天的活动。
examples.py: dú shū hé liáo tiān , shì jīn tiān de huó dòng .
examples.en: Reading and chatting are today’s activity.

examples.zh: 年轻的老师很热情，大家参加活动。
examples.py: nián qīng de lǎo shī hěn rè qíng , dà jiā cān jiā huó dòng .
examples.en: The young teacher is welcoming; everyone joins the activity.

examples.zh: 这篇文章，我读懂了。大家热情，是我的看法。
examples.py: zhè piān wén zhāng , wǒ dú dǒng le . dà jiā rè qíng , shì wǒ de kàn fa .
examples.en: I have read and understood this passage. “Everyone is welcoming” is my impression.

commonMistakes.why: In this basic verb-object phrase the action 参加 precedes its object 活动.

grammar.pattern: 可能 / 可以 / 会 + action
grammar.purpose: Separate possibility, permission and predicted events
grammar.explanation: 可能 expresses uncertainty: 明天可能下雨. 可以 can grant permission or indicate feasibility: 可以参加. 会 can predict an event: 明天会下雨, as well as learned ability from earlier lessons. A prediction is not proof; use 可能 when uncertain. Put the modal before the main action and use 不可能/不可以/不会 for the relevant negative meaning.

examples.zh: 我可以参加吗？可以，明天可能还有新同学。
examples.py: wǒ kě yǐ cān jiā ma ? kě yǐ , míng tiān kě néng hái yǒu xīn tóng xué .
examples.en: May I join? Yes; there may be more new classmates tomorrow.

examples.zh: 我会说一点普通话。明天可能下雨，也可能不下。
examples.py: wǒ huì shuō yī diǎn pǔ tōng huà . míng tiān kě néng xià yǔ , yě kě néng bù xià .
examples.en: I can speak a little Mandarin. It may rain tomorrow, or it may not.

commonMistakes.why: Do not combine a certainty claim with uncertain 可能 for the same prediction.

dialogue.title: One new member
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find what the new learner may join and who is included.

lines.zh: 大家好，我是来自越南的留学生。
lines.py: dà jiā hǎo , wǒ shì lái zì yuè nán de liú xué shēng .
lines.en: Hello everyone; I am an international student from Vietnam.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 欢迎！我自己也刚来，想交朋友。
lines.py: huān yíng ! wǒ zì jǐ yě gāng lái , xiǎng jiāo péng yǒu .
lines.en: Welcome! I have also just arrived and want to make friends.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你们是同一个年级的吗？
lines.py: nǐ men shì tóng yī gè nián jí de ma ?
lines.en: Are you in the same school year?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是。班长和我同年级，别人不一定。
lines.py: bù shì . bān zhǎng hé wǒ tóng nián jí , bié ren bù yí dìng .
lines.en: No. The class monitor and I are in the same year; the others are not necessarily.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我可以参加你们的小组吗？
lines.py: wǒ kě yǐ cān jiā nǐ men de xiǎo zǔ ma ?
lines.en: May I join your small group?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 可以。四个人组成一个组，你来就有五个人。
lines.py: kě yǐ . sì gè rén zǔ chéng yī gè zǔ , nǐ lái jiù yǒu wǔ gè rén .
lines.en: Yes. Four people form one group; with you, there will be five.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 组长是谁？她看起来很年轻。
lines.py: zǔ zhǎng shì shéi ? tā kàn qǐ lái hěn nián qīng .
lines.en: Who is the group leader? She looks young.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那位同学。她很热情，大家也很友好。
lines.py: nà wèi tóng xué . tā hěn rè qíng , dà jiā yě hěn yǒu hǎo .
lines.en: That classmate. She is welcoming, and everyone is friendly.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 今天有什么活动？我想练普通话。
lines.py: jīn tiān yǒu shén me huó dòng ? wǒ xiǎng liàn pǔ tōng huà .
lines.en: What activities are there today? I want to practise Mandarin.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 咱们先读书，再聊天。咱一起读吧。
lines.py: zán men xiān dú shū , zài liáo tiān . zán yì qǐ dú ba .
lines.en: Let us read first, then chat. Let us read together.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这两本书可以用吗？它们是你的吗？
lines.py: zhè liǎng běn shū kě yǐ yòng ma ? tā men shì nǐ de ma ?
lines.en: May we use these two books? Are they yours?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 可以，它们是小组的。明天可能下雨，明天的活动先不定。
lines.py: kě yǐ , tā men shì xiǎo zǔ de . míng tiān kě néng xià yǔ , míng tiān de huó dòng xiān bù dìng .
lines.en: Yes, they belong to the group. It may rain tomorrow; tomorrow’s activity is not decided yet.
lines.speaker: b

choices: Join the group and practise Mandarin

reading.title: A small group, not one year group
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read to identify the people, books and uncertain plan.

lines.zh: 我是留学生，来自越南。我想交朋友，也想练普通话。
lines.py: wǒ shì liú xué shēng , lái zì yuè nán . wǒ xiǎng jiāo péng yǒu , yě xiǎng liàn pǔ tōng huà .
lines.en: I am an international student from Vietnam. I want to make friends and practise Mandarin.

lines.zh: 今天我参加一个小组。原来四个人组成一个组，我来以后有五个人。
lines.py: jīn tiān wǒ cān jiā yī gè xiǎo zǔ . yuán lái sì gè rén zǔ chéng yī gè zǔ , wǒ lái yǐ hòu yǒu wǔ gè rén .
lines.en: Today I joined a small group. Originally four people formed it; after I joined there were five.

lines.zh: 组长很年轻，也很热情。班长也在，大家对我很友好。
lines.py: zǔ zhǎng hěn nián qīng , yě hěn rè qíng . bān zhǎng yě zài , dà jiā duì wǒ hěn yǒu hǎo .
lines.en: The group leader is young and welcoming. The class monitor is there too, and everyone is friendly to me.

lines.zh: 我们不是一个年级的，班长和一位同学同年级。
lines.py: wǒ men bù shì yī gè nián jí de , bān zhǎng hé yī wèi tóng xué tóng nián jí .
lines.en: We are not all in one school year; the monitor and one classmate are in the same year.

lines.zh: 大家先介绍自己，再听别人介绍。今天的活动是读书和聊天。
lines.py: dà jiā xiān jiè shào zì jǐ , zài tīng bié ren jiè shào . jīn tiān de huó dòng shì dú shū hé liáo tiān .
lines.en: Everyone introduces themselves first, then listens to others. Today’s activity is reading and chatting.

lines.zh: 桌上有两本书，它们是小组的。我问可以用吗，组长说可以。
lines.py: zhuō shàng yǒu liǎng běn shū , tā men shì xiǎo zǔ de . wǒ wèn kě yǐ yòng ma , zǔ zhǎng shuō kě yǐ .
lines.en: There are two books on the table; they belong to the group. I asked if I could use them and the leader said yes.

lines.zh: 组长说咱们一起读，咱们也包括我。这个群有十个人，它比今天的小组大。
lines.py: zǔ zhǎng shuō zán men yì qǐ dú , zán men yě bāo kuò wǒ . zhè gè qún yǒu shí gè rén , tā bǐ jīn tiān de xiǎo zǔ dà .
lines.en: The leader said we would all read together, including me. The group chat has ten people; it is larger than today’s small group.

lines.zh: 明天可能下雨，组长还没定活动。可以参加，不是已经定了明天的时间。
lines.py: míng tiān kě néng xià yǔ , zǔ zhǎng hái méi dìng huó dòng . kě yǐ cān jiā , bù shì yǐ jīng dìng le míng tiān de shí jiān .
lines.en: It may rain tomorrow; the leader has not decided the activity. Being allowed to join does not mean tomorrow’s time is already settled.

choices: A learner joins a welcoming study group
